paper_id: FedAdapter_ Efficient Federated Learning for Modern NLP
title: FedAdapter: Efficient Federated Learning for Modern NLP
motivation: FedNLP训练因大模型和高通信开销极慢,需实用化
problem_framing: Adapter配置空间大且无银弹配置,需自动化
key_insight: 渐进训练+旁路试验可快速学习浅层知识并探测最优配置
method_signature: Adapter配置动态演进+跨轮激活缓存
evaluation_criteria: 时间到精度/网络流量/能耗
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: Layer freezing收益有限,选错配置可使收敛慢4.7倍
evidence_for_taste: Picking a non-optimal configuration could slow down model convergence by up to 4.7x
the profits of such an approach are modest
the optimal configuration varies across downstream NLP tasks
the convergence rate often sees diminishing returns as the population of participant devices grows
thinking_moves: 识别关键瓶颈:从全模型微调到adapter只需调<1%参数
将参数高效学习思想迁移到联邦学习系统设计
借鉴课程学习思想:从浅层到深层渐进提升模型复杂度
利用联邦学习中多余设备的边际效益递减特性做配置试验
跨轮缓存固定层的激活值避免重复计算
